title: Using Everyone Pay for rent or allowance
summary: This document explains how to use Everyone Pay for rent or allowance by setting each recurring/scheduled payment at or below $3,000, matching the agreed rent amount. It recommends scheduling so funds arrive before the recipient’s due date and using the 3-days-before reminder to verify and adjust future cycles after checking activity.
faqs: What is the maximum amount I can schedule for rent or allowance using Everyone Pay?
How should I set the recurring rent amount to match our agreed payment?
When should I schedule payments so they arrive before the recipient’s due date?
How can I use the 3-day reminder to verify funds and make adjustments?
What should I check after each payment to confirm the processed amount matches what I scheduled?
How do I update future payments if my rent/allowance agreement changes?
